## Changes

- **Performers.** Every performer is now kept once, in the **Performers** window, with their name, other names, nationality, date of birth, active years, IAFD page and your own attributes. Add, edit, merge and remove them there, and see every folder and scene that names them across your whole collection.
- **Several performers per folder or scene.** Choose them in **Edit details**, or type a new name to add one. A scene can name its own performers as well as its folder's, and **Edit scenes** can add or take off a performer on many scenes at once.
- **Your existing details are moved across** the first time this version opens. Each folder's first name becomes its performer, with any other names kept as their other names. Folders without names are given one from the folder's name, so some may need tidying or merging. A copy of your catalogue is kept first, as `index-before-performers.db.gz` in your data folder.
- **Performer links in the folder details.** An open folder lists its performers, each a link to their page. A folder of one performer still shows their age, nationality, years and attributes.
- **Search and filters by performer** now match any of their names, and find folders whose scenes name them too. Attributes, nationality and active years go by the performers.
- **Rate folders.** Click a star on a folder's tile, or set it in Edit details. Sort folders by **Rating**, or filter for 3 stars or more, 4 or more, 5, or unrated.
- **Move a folder to another drive.** Right-click a folder and choose **Move to another drive...**. It checks there's room, copies the videos, checks every copy, points the folder at it, and only then removes the originals if you ask it to. If anything goes wrong, nothing changes.
- **Check files for damage.** **Collection > Check Files for Damage...**, or right-click a folder. A quick check reads the start and end of each video and finds files that won't open or were cut short. A thorough check reads them right through. Damaged files are tagged **corrupt**.
